style.background: deep charcoal-navy with scene-specific earthy gradients, subtle paper grain
style.linework: warm off-white hand-drawn 7px rounded strokes, deliberately imperfect but clean
style.character: simple large-headed doodle figure, expressive pose, thick silhouette, never tiny
style.motion: restrained; usually one camera move plus one meaningful object/character motion
style.captions: 2-5 words, lower safe-zone unless focal subject occupies bottom, off-white with one accented word max

scenes.layout: human lower-left 35%; enormous physical toggle upper-right 50%
scenes.motion: slow 3% push; switch handle trembles but does not flip

scenes.layout: wide side-view bedroom timeline
scenes.background: desk left, bed right, moon window
scenes.motion: camera drifts right while switch flips and character match-cuts from seated to lying

scenes.layout: giant brain centered 65% frame, binary switch embedded inside
scenes.motion: switch cracks into six tiny local switches
scenes.visualMetaphor: one switch breaks into distributed states

scenes.layout: mouse profile lower-left; transparent enlarged brain occupies right two-thirds
scenes.motion: mouse walks slowly while only selected cortical patch pulses ON/OFF

scenes.layout: 30-minute clock huge left; three mouse memory paths right
scenes.motion: clock hand sweeps then third lane catches first lane

scenes.layout: split human brain floats above tiny centered awake figure
scenes.motion: camera pulls back as question mark emerges between person and brain

scenes.layout: stadium bowl fills frame; neuron-like spectators are points with tiny connecting arcs
scenes.motion: slow aerial pull-out

scenes.layout: same stadium geometry preserved from s07
scenes.motion: section lights click off sequentially, gates close

scenes.layout: brain-city map seen top-down, six districts with different fatigue levels
scenes.motion: different district meters rise; one abruptly drops into slow-wave

scenes.layout: single cortical island centered, surrounded by awake glowing tissue
scenes.motion: one slow wave passes across patch

scenes.layout: office worker foreground right; transparent head overlay left with one dim circuit
scenes.motion: worker keeps typing while local network flickers out
scenes.visualMetaphor: behavior stays awake while one circuit checks out

scenes.layout: computer screen large center with nonsensical output; worker small but readable left
scenes.motion: cursor types wrong symbol repeatedly; brain patch briefly darkens

scenes.layout: chaotic wave field left transforms into clean rhythmic wave right
scenes.motion: messy pulses snap into measured ON/OFF cadence
scenes.visualMetaphor: accidental local sleep becomes controlled experiment

scenes.layout: mouse brain cross-section centered; four rows of neurons light alternately
scenes.motion: amber pulse → dark → amber → dark, synchronized to SFX

scenes.layout: left panel flat dimming, right panel rhythmic slow wave; no UI chrome, just physical diagrams
scenes.motion: left fades uselessly; right locks into rhythm

scenes.layout: two translucent waves overlay until peaks align exactly
scenes.motion: one wave slides horizontally until alignment

scenes.layout: brain patch with battery icon integrated into tissue; sleeping mouse silhouette lower-right
scenes.motion: battery fills, later slow wave over same patch becomes smaller

scenes.layout: mouse at fork between familiar and novel floor texture
scenes.motion: camera tracks mouse toward textures

scenes.layout: three horizontal physical race lanes with mouse icons, no chart frame
scenes.motion: rested and stimulated finish together; deprived lags

scenes.layout: awake mouse centered; one cortical patch glowing blue-rested inside transparent head
scenes.motion: slow push-in; local patch breathes softly
scenes.visualMetaphor: local sleep benefit without whole-animal unconsciousness

scenes.layout: mouse experiment left, sleeping human right, thick hand-drawn boundary between
scenes.motion: boundary draws itself downward
scenes.visualMetaphor: do not leap from mouse result to human sleep replacement

scenes.layout: mouse silhouette stretches into dolphin body on shared horizontal axis
scenes.motion: single clean silhouette morph
scenes.visualMetaphor: nature already evolved a stronger solution

scenes.layout: dolphin lower-middle beneath bright water surface; breath route marked by one amber arc
scenes.motion: dolphin glides upward then levels
scenes.visualMetaphor: sleep competes with need to breathe

scenes.layout: transparent dolphin head occupies center; hemispheres are clear left/right masses

subjects.state: left asleep right awake then swap

scenes.motion: blue slow waves move on one side, then crossfade to the other

scenes.layout: extreme dolphin eye/head close-up, crossing visual pathway lines in one elegant diagram
scenes.motion: open eye blinks once; opposite hemisphere glows
scenes.visualMetaphor: sleep with one eye open is nearly literal

scenes.layout: dolphin leap arc match-cuts into bird wing arc
scenes.motion: one fluid match cut
scenes.visualMetaphor: same compromise moves from water to air

scenes.layout: frigatebird large foreground gliding, ocean tiny below; visible lightweight recorder on head
scenes.motion: camera follows bird with 3% drift; small sleep wave traces behind

scenes.layout: bird circles a giant clock ring in open sky; 0.69 is the only large number
scenes.motion: bird orbits number once; number settles
scenes.visualMetaphor: sleep in flight is possible but scarce

scenes.layout: bird glides through a sequence of small blue sleep bubbles spaced across frame
scenes.motion: bird crosses; bubbles briefly envelop head then pop

scenes.layout: human center foreground; dolphin left background; split brain right background
scenes.motion: camera pushes toward human as animal references slide outward
scenes.visualMetaphor: return the question to the viewer

scenes.layout: dolphin brain left with crisp 50/50 split, human brain right with patchy asymmetric gradient
scenes.motion: clean dividing line on human side dissolves into irregular patches
scenes.visualMetaphor: human sleep is not clean one-sided sleep

scenes.layout: sleep lab bed right; brain overlay left; sound pulse enters from far left
scenes.motion: sound pulse crosses; less-sleeping side reacts first

scenes.layout: same bed repeated as three ghosted nights left-to-right
scenes.motion: night labels advance with three ticks; highlight fades

scenes.layout: human brain center with false neat split line erased and replaced by nuanced patchwork
scenes.motion: eraser-like wipe removes 50/50 split; irregular gradients emerge

scenes.layout: brain-shaped terrain from bright sunrise zone to dark moonlit zone without hard boundary
scenes.motion: camera glides across gradient terrain

scenes.layout: brain becomes a miniature city of six districts, each with distinct work and light state
scenes.motion: subtle parallax between districts; no dashboard labels
scenes.visualMetaphor: many circuits, many workloads, many states

scenes.layout: four-beat horizontal montage with shared central pulse line, not boxed panels
scenes.motion: pulse line travels across each beat and activates it

scenes.layout: future office worker large center wearing minimal research headband; rested brain patch visible
scenes.motion: subtle push; patch slow-wave pulses once
scenes.visualMetaphor: future possibility, not existing consumer device

scenes.layout: mouse experiment on left connected by dotted cautious arrow to human research silhouette right
scenes.motion: arrow draws halfway, pauses, then completes faintly
scenes.visualMetaphor: translation is a research question, not a fact

scenes.layout: small local brain patch left versus full sleeping human spanning right two-thirds; systems orbit body
scenes.background: night bedroom fading into nature where bird lands
scenes.motion: local patch stays small as camera reveals whole-body system; bird lands and settles
scenes.visualMetaphor: local restoration is tiny compared with full sleep

scenes.layout: evolutionary mural: dolphin, frigatebird, mouse, human arranged around central sleeping brain
scenes.motion: slow 4% pull-out; each animal gets one tiny characteristic motion
scenes.visualMetaphor: evolution keeps finding ways to pay sleep debt

scenes.layout: human in bed lower foreground; brain rises into enormous twilight landscape filling frame
scenes.background: bedroom dissolves into abstract dawn-to-night landscape
scenes.motion: very slow pull-out; different landscape districts dim at different moments; final frame holds 1.5s
scenes.visualMetaphor: awake/asleep is a landscape, not a line
